sections.heading: The ceremony
sections.intro: The wooden arch Dave built by hand for Nick and Alex's wedding in 2022. It now stands on the ceremony lawn, and it's yours to say your vows under.

sections.heading: The barns
sections.intro: Two restored barns — one for dinner, one for dancing. Hand-built beams, string lights, and open decks that look out over the valley.
